in_sanskrit.name: शरुणिकाशा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Sharunikaasha is derived from the Sanskrit words 'sharuṇi' (Goddess of prosperity) and 'kāśa' (abode or dwelling). The name thus means 'the abode of the Goddess of prosperity'.

in_hindi.name: शरुणिकाशा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Sharunikaasha in Hindi translates to 'ghar' (house) of 'sharuṇi' (Goddess of prosperity).
